title: An invoice deleted after load shows the not-found state and back returns
preconds:
1. The report is open with an invoice detail row visible.
2. In another tab/session, that invoice is deleted or reversed AFTER the report loaded (do not refresh the report)..
steps:
1. Back in the report (unrefreshed), click that invoice's number link.
2. Read the destination page, then press the browser back button.
expected:
1. The destination page shows the application's standard "not found" state.
2. Pressing back returns you to the report.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Sales By Customer report specification version 20 (S9-N1), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-da72171 on 8/19/2026.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - waiting on the product owner to decide whether the invoice number is a clickable link (it currently shows as plain non-clickable text and the specification is contradictory); this test depends on that decision
